name: XPR Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Extensible Cross-Platform Point-Based Differentiable Renderer pipeline
XPR: An Extensible Cross-Platform Point-Based Differentiable Renderer
definition: A rendering pipeline that decouples method-specific logic from the pipeline structure by exposing four user-defined functions: project, tile_cull, pixel_info, and evaluate. It handles parallelization, data layout, and scheduling automatically via JAX/XLA, supporting automatic differentiation.
summary: XPR is an extensible, cross-platform point-based differentiable renderer that decouples method-specific logic from the shared pipeline via a four-function interface, enabling portable execution across GPUs, TPUs, and CPUs.
